label.zh: X V1.1 / 机械安装程序

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。
value.en: Assemble against the exact model drawing; use consistent threadlocker location and quantity on fixing screws; seat without tightening, snug diagonally, then torque diagonally with a torque wrench. Clean mating surfaces first.

overview.zh: RMD-X2-P28-7-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X2-P28-7-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：28.17；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：37 W；额定扭矩：2.5 Nm；重量：0.26 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 28.17; Rated voltage: 24 V; Rated power: 37 W; Rated torque: 2.5 Nm; Weight: 0.26 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P12-10-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P12-10-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：12.5；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：100 W；额定扭矩：4 Nm；重量：0.33 kg

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P36-36-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P36-36-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：36；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：100 W；额定扭矩：10.5 Nm；重量：0.36 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 36; Rated voltage: 24 V; Rated power: 100 W; Rated torque: 10.5 Nm; Weight: 0.36 kg

label.zh: X V1.1 / 机械安装程序

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。
value.en: Assemble against the exact model drawing; use consistent threadlocker location and quantity on fixing screws; seat without tightening, snug diagonally, then torque diagonally with a torque wrench. Clean mating surfaces first.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P20-60-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P20-60-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：19.61；额定电压：48 V；额定功率：320 W；额定扭矩：20 Nm；重量：0.82 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 19.61; Rated voltage: 48 V; Rated power: 320 W; Rated torque: 20 Nm; Weight: 0.82 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P9-32-R 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P9-32-R is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：9；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：204 W；额定扭矩：8 Nm；重量：0.53 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 9; Rated voltage: 24 V; Rated power: 204 W; Rated torque: 8 Nm; Weight: 0.53 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P20-120-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P20-120-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：19.61；额定电压：48 V；额定功率：574 W；额定扭矩：43 Nm；重量：1.4 kg

label.zh: X V1.1 / 机械安装程序

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。
value.en: Assemble against the exact model drawing; use consistent threadlocker location and quantity on fixing screws; seat without tightening, snug diagonally, then torque diagonally with a torque wrench. Clean mating surfaces first.

overview.zh: RMD-X12-P20-320-E 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X12-P20-320-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：20；额定电压：48 V；额定功率：900 W；额定扭矩：85 Nm；重量：2.37 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 20; Rated voltage: 48 V; Rated power: 900 W; Rated torque: 85 Nm; Weight: 2.37 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.en: RMD-X15-P20-450-E is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P12-10-E-L 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P12-10-E-L is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：12.5；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：100 W；额定扭矩：4 Nm；重量：0.33 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 12.5; Rated voltage: 24 V; Rated power: 100 W; Rated torque: 4 Nm; Weight: 0.33 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P36-36-E-L 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P36-36-E-L is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：36；额定电压：24 V；额定功率：100 W；额定扭矩：10.5 Nm；重量：0.36 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 36; Rated voltage: 24 V; Rated power: 100 W; Rated torque: 10.5 Nm; Weight: 0.36 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P20-50-E-L 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P20-50-E-L is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：19.61；额定电压：48 V；额定功率：320 W；额定扭矩：20 Nm；重量：0.78 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 19.61; Rated voltage: 48 V; Rated power: 320 W; Rated torque: 20 Nm; Weight: 0.78 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P20-150-E-03 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P20-150-E-03 is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：19.61；额定电压：48 V；额定功率：574 W；额定扭矩：43 Nm；重量：1.33 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 19.61; Rated voltage: 48 V; Rated power: 574 W; Rated torque: 43 Nm; Weight: 1.33 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-CEM-25-E-N 是脉塔的摆线关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-CEM-25-E-N is MYACTUATOR's cycloidal joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：30；额定转矩：15 Nm；通信方式：CAN BUS / EtherCAT；重量：0.94 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 30; Rated torque: 15 Nm; Communication interface: CAN BUS / EtherCAT; Weight: 0.94 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-CEM-45-E-N 是脉塔的摆线关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-CEM-45-E-N is MYACTUATOR's cycloidal joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 减速比：30；额定转矩：25 Nm；通信方式：CAN BUS / EtherCAT；重量：1.09 kg
overview.en: Reduction ratio: 30; Rated torque: 25 Nm; Communication interface: CAN BUS / EtherCAT; Weight: 1.09 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-H-50-15-100-C 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: RMD-H-50-15-100-C is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 V；额定功率：91.6 W；额定扭矩：0.35 Nm；重量：0.24 kg；通信方式：CAN BUS

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成

overview.zh: RMD-H-70-15-200-C 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: RMD-H-70-15-200-C is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 V；额定功率：200 W；额定扭矩：0.8 Nm；重量：0.47 kg；通信方式：CAN BUS
overview.en: Rated voltage: 48 V; Rated power: 200 W; Rated torque: 0.8 Nm; Weight: 0.47 kg; Communication interface: CAN BUS

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-FL-38-08-100 是脉塔的无框力矩电机。定子与转子直接集成到机构中输出转矩，省去独立电机外壳；控制器、传感器和轴承配置需按型号核对。
overview.en: RMD-FL-38-08-100 is MYACTUATOR's frameless torque motor. Stator and rotor integrate into the mechanism to produce torque without a separate motor housing. Check the controller, sensing and bearings for the exact model.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.1 Nm；额定功率：94 W；重量：0.05 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.1 Nm; Rated power: 94 W; Weight: 0.05 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: RMD-FL-38-12-240 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FL-38-12-240 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.23 Nm；额定功率：240 W；重量：0.1 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.23 Nm; Rated power: 240 W; Weight: 0.1 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: RMD-FL-70-10-250 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FL-70-10-250 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.55 Nm；额定功率：201 W；重量：0.25 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.55 Nm; Rated power: 201 W; Weight: 0.25 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: RMD-FL-70-16-360 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FL-70-16-360 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：1.3 Nm；额定功率：408 W；重量：0.32 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 1.3 Nm; Rated power: 408 W; Weight: 0.32 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机

overview.zh: RMD-FLO-40-15-50 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FLO-40-15-50 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.15 Nm；额定功率：47 W；重量：0.13 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.15 Nm; Rated power: 47 W; Weight: 0.13 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: RMD-FLO-50-15-100 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FLO-50-15-100 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.35 Nm；额定功率：91.6 W；重量：0.19 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.35 Nm; Rated power: 91.6 W; Weight: 0.19 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: RMD-FLO-70-15-200 的定子与转子用于直接集成到机器人机构，型号后缀对应所列绝对值反馈选项。编码器分辨率和安装方式以该选项资料为准，不能套用无后缀电机的传感器配置。
overview.en: RMD-FLO-70-15-200 integrates its stator and rotor into a robot mechanism, with the suffix identifying the listed absolute-feedback option. Encoder resolution and mounting follow this option's documentation, not assumptions from the unsuffixed motor.

overview.zh: 额定扭矩：0.8 Nm；额定功率：200 W；重量：0.33 kg
overview.en: Rated torque: 0.8 Nm; Rated power: 200 W; Weight: 0.33 kg

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

type.zh: 带公开编码器选项的无框力矩电机
type.en: Frameless torque motor with published encoder option

overview.zh: L-4010 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: L-4010 is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: L-4015 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: L-4015 is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: L-5005 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: L-5005 is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: L-7015 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: L-7015 is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: L-7025 是脉塔的直驱电机模组。直接驱动负载的旋转运动，适合需要紧凑布置和闭环调速定位的机器人机构。
overview.en: L-7025 is MYACTUATOR's direct-drive motor module. Directly drives rotary loads in compact robot mechanisms requiring closed-loop speed and position control.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P6-3-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P6-3-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 30 W; Rated Torque: 1.5 N.m; Weight: 300 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.en: RMD-X4-P6-3-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P6-7-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P6-7-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 150 W; Rated Torque: 3.5 N.m; Weight: 350 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P6-7-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P6-7-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：150 W；额定扭矩：3.5 N.m；重量：350 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 150 W; Rated Torque: 3.5 N.m; Weight: 350 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P36-40-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P36-40-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 170 W; Rated Torque: 18 N.m; Weight: 590 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P36-40-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P36-40-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：170 W；额定扭矩：18 N.m；重量：590 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 170 W; Rated Torque: 18 N.m; Weight: 590 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P9-25-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P9-25-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 125 W; Rated Torque: 10 N.m; Weight: 710 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P9-25-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P9-25-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：125 W；额定扭矩：10 N.m；重量：710 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 125 W; Rated Torque: 10 N.m; Weight: 710 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P8-8-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P8-8-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 135 W; Rated Torque: 4.5 N.m; Weight: 490 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P8-8-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P8-8-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：135 W；额定扭矩：4.5 N.m；重量：490 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 135 W; Rated Torque: 4.5 N.m; Weight: 490 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P6-20-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P6-20-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 200 W; Rated Torque: 10 N.m; Weight: 780 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P36-60-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P36-60-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 130 W; Rated Torque: 30 N.m; Weight: 900 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P36-60-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P36-60-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：130 W；额定扭矩：30 N.m；重量：900 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 130 W; Rated Torque: 30 N.m; Weight: 900 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X10-P7-40-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X10-P7-40-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 265 W; Rated Torque: 15 N.m; Weight: 1150 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X10-P7-40-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X10-P7-40-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X10-P35-100-R-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X10-P35-100-R-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Rated Power: 265 W; Rated Torque: 50 N.m; Weight: 1700 g; Communication interface: RS485; 115200 / 500K / 1M / 2.5M

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X10-P35-100-C-N 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X10-P35-100-C-N is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定功率：265 W；额定扭矩：50 N.m；重量：1700 g；通信方式：CAN; 1 Mbit/s
overview.en: Rated Power: 265 W; Rated Torque: 50 N.m; Weight: 1700 g; Communication interface: CAN; 1 Mbit/s

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-32-100-E-N-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-32-100-E-N-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：150(N.m)；额定功率：282(W)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 150(N.m); Rated Power: 282(W)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-32-100-E-B-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-32-100-E-B-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：150(N.m)；额定功率：282(W)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 150(N.m); Rated Power: 282(W)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-14-100-E-N-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-14-100-E-N-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：11(N.m)；额定功率：28(W)；重量：0.78(KG)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 11(N.m); Rated Power: 28(W); Weight: 0.78(KG)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-17-100-E-N-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-17-100-E-N-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：35(N.m)；额定功率：91(W)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 35(N.m); Rated Power: 91(W)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-17-100-E-B-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-17-100-E-B-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X8-P20-120-C 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X8-P20-120-C is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-25-100-E-N-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-25-100-E-N-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：108(N.m)；额定功率：282(W)；重量：2.42(KG)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 108(N.m); Rated Power: 282(W); Weight: 2.42(KG)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-25-100-E-B-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-25-100-E-B-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：108(N.m)；额定功率：282(W)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 108(N.m); Rated Power: 282(W)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

label.zh: X V1.1 / 多模组供电拓扑

value.zh: 单轴直连的线阻和压降较小，推荐用于大功率模组；链型拓扑用于小功率模组。勿串联其他用电设备。
value.en: Single-axis direct supply has lower wiring resistance and voltage drop and is recommended for high-power modules; chain topology is recommended for low-power modules. Do not insert other electrical loads in series.

label.zh: X V1.1 / 机械安装程序

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。

overview.zh: RMD-X2-P28-7-C 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X2-P28-7-C is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

label.zh: X V1.1 / 多模组供电拓扑

value.zh: 单轴直连的线阻和压降较小，推荐用于大功率模组；链型拓扑用于小功率模组。勿串联其他用电设备。
value.en: Single-axis direct supply has lower wiring resistance and voltage drop and is recommended for high-power modules; chain topology is recommended for low-power modules. Do not insert other electrical loads in series.

label.zh: X V1.1 / 机械安装程序

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。
value.en: Assemble against the exact model drawing; use consistent threadlocker location and quantity on fixing screws; seat without tightening, snug diagonally, then torque diagonally with a torque wrench. Clean mating surfaces first.

overview.zh: RMD-X6-P20-60-C 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X6-P20-60-C is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Weight: 0.82(KG)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-20-100-E-N-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-20-100-E-N-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.
Weight: 1.45(KG)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: EPS-RH-20-100-E-B-D 是脉塔的谐波关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: EPS-RH-20-100-E-B-D is MYACTUATOR's harmonic joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48(V)；额定转矩：50(N.m)；额定功率：130(W)；重量：1.75(KG)
overview.en: Rated Voltage: 48(V); Rated Torque: 50(N.m); Rated Power: 130(W); Weight: 1.75(KG)

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

value.zh: 按对应型号图纸装配；固定螺丝使用位置、用量一致的螺纹胶；先拧到底不拧紧，再对角预紧，最后用扭矩扳手对角拧紧。安装前清理配合面。

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P36-36-C 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P36-36-C is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

overview.zh: RMD-X4-P12-10-C 是脉塔的行星关节模组。将电机、减速传动、反馈与驱动集成为关节单元，用于闭环控制机器人机构的位置、速度及输出力矩。具体通信接口取决于型号后缀。
overview.en: RMD-X4-P12-10-C is MYACTUATOR's planetary joint module. Combines a motor, reduction stage, feedback and drive into a joint unit for closed-loop position, speed and torque control. The ordered suffix determines the interface.

applications.zh: 机器人关节、自动化运动与研发系统集成
applications.en: Robot joints, automation motion and research-system integration

integration.zh: 按型号、代际、供电、减速比和反馈配置核对。CAN 与 EtherCAT 的可选配置不代表每个出货版本均具备所有接口。
integration.en: Check the model, generation, supply, reduction ratio and feedback configuration. CAN and EtherCAT options do not establish that every shipped version includes both.

verification.zh: 选型判断：额定、峰值和堵转不是同一工况；需要结合占空比、散热和机械安装验证。公开表中空白项不按零值或满足要求处理。
verification.en: Selection assessment: rated, peak and stall values describe different conditions. Validate duty cycle, cooling and mechanical installation. Blank published fields are neither zero nor evidence of compliance.

label.en: Official archive containing historical FLO manual

gaps.reason: The download center links this exact ZIP, which returned HTTP 404. Individual L-model archives were downloaded successfully; no standalone driver-board dimensions or complete electrical pin table were found for MC100/MC200.

gaps.item: Seven older parameter sheets retain unmapped historical names
gaps.reason: Seven paired 240220 parameter sheets use historical names rather than the canonical full model names. Their companion 240403 full-model tables were extracted; the older sheets are retained with exact archive-member identities in archive-parameter-delta.json, not assigned by filename alone.

Fifteen field differences remain in parameter-delta.json, including nominal-versus-tolerance or strict-versus-inclusive boundary differences; they are not fifteen independently confirmed engineering contradictions. RH17 50:1/100:1 option columns are now correctly attributed and are not counted as torque/speed conflicts.

Archive X8-150 identifies the base E model without the existing -03 suffix; base-model facts are explicitly conditional. X4-10 source names P12.5 while the web identity uses P12. Two -E absolute-feedback FL options are explicitly named and retained as separate offered configurations.

gaps.item: Remaining diagrams, curves and broad user manuals
gaps.reason: All 43 identified one-page parameter PDFs were inspected; 36 have exact canonical-model attribution and seven older sheets retain historical names. All geometric main-table rows that map unambiguously were added, including shaded rows. Full sampled curves and every mechanical tolerance in drawing-only pages, plus broad user-manual protocol contents, are not all structured. These are readable public residuals, not access failures.
